SELECT t.tradekind,
       COUNT(ab.abhvreg) AS record_count,
       COUNT(ab.abhvreg)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(ab.abhvreg)) OVER () AS share
FROM advancedbehavior ab
JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
GROUP BY t.tradekind
ORDER BY record_count DESC;
